differences.writeup_quote: The structural recipe (contrastive stance at the concept-allocation band, prefix positions, large dose, plain J-lens readout unchanged) follows Raman (2026).

rationale: The write-up explicitly credits Raman (2026)/white-bear steering as the origin of the structural recipe (band, positions, dose, readout) while laying out exactly which parts (stance wording, data, family framing) are novel; the message names Raman 2026 and reports the same comparison numbers (cosine 0.73, fit pass@10 0.78 vs 0.69, the four-stance table) but frames it only as a novelty contrast ('not a reproduction of'), never stating outright that the structural recipe itself follows Raman (2026). Otherwise the two documents agree on every figure and on the three novelty points (different stance, self-written prompts, family-of-stances finding), so the only material gap is the write-up's more explicit admission of structural lineage, which the message softens.
